Existing Message: Unauthorized
Problem: Bare authorization label gives no recovery; 401 differs from 403.
Recommended Message: Please sign in to continue.

Existing Message: Forbidden
Problem: Technical access label with no next step.
Recommended Message: You don't have permission to perform this action. Ask your system administrator if you need access.

Existing Message: Database unavailable.
Problem: Implementation detail reaches guest and staff screens.
Recommended Message: This service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

Existing Message: Xendit sandbox is not configured. Contact the hotel.
Problem: Guest cannot configure provider credentials; keep the separate sandbox disclosure.
Recommended Message: Online payment is unavailable right now. Please contact Front Desk for help with your booking.

Existing Message: Xendit cannot offer this wallet in the current sandbox account. Check channel availability in the Xendit Dashboard, or try the other wallet.
Problem: Guest receives provider dashboard instructions. This is a definitive channel rejection, not an unknown charge.
Recommended Message: This wallet is unavailable right now. Choose another available wallet or contact Front Desk.

Existing Message: Xendit rejected sandbox checkout. Check test key permissions and sandbox setup, then retry.
Problem: Developer setup instructions are shown to guests.
Recommended Message: We couldn't open online checkout. Please try again shortly or contact Front Desk.

Existing Message: Xendit has not confirmed checkout creation. We are keeping this attempt pending to prevent duplicates.
Problem: Correct uncertainty; provider and duplicate-prevention mechanics obscure the next step.
Recommended Message: We're checking your payment attempt. Please don't start another payment. Check your reservation for updates.

Existing Message: Waiting for the payment provider. Your booking is still unpaid.
Problem: A missing response does not establish that payment was not received; prefer pending confirmation.
Recommended Message: We're waiting for payment confirmation. Check your reservation before making another payment.

Existing Message: We could not hold this room. Please try again.
Problem: Catch includes failures after the hold transaction. A saved hold can exist despite the error response.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm your room hold. Try again with the same details to check this booking attempt.

Existing Message: Could not confirm your hold. Retry to recover the same booking attempt.
Problem: Truthful but uses internal retry terminology.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm your room hold. Try again with the same details to check this booking attempt.

Existing Message: async function handleCancelSubmit()
Problem: Fetch/JSON rejection reaches finally with no catch; the outcome is unknown and there is no helpful feedback.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm the cancellation. Check My reservations before trying again.

Existing Message: async function handleChangeSubmit()
Problem: Fetch/JSON rejection has no catch. Preserve request key and draft; check reservation before resubmitting.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm your change request. Check your reservation and request status before trying again.

Existing Message: const response = await fetch
Problem: No catch/finally: rejected fetch/JSON can leave the form loading indefinitely. A new key is generated on each submit.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm your request. Check My requests before sending it again.

Existing Message: const response = await fetch
Problem: No catch/finally around submission; loading can stick and a saved request may be unconfirmed.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm your transportation request. Check your transportation requests before sending it again.

Existing Message: const idempotencyKey = crypto.randomUUID();
Problem: A fresh key on each click contradicts the stable-retry comment; no catch for an uncertain create. Copy alone cannot make retry safe.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm this reservation. Check Reservations before creating another booking for this guest.

Existing Message: if (res.status === 409)
Problem: Every conflict is described as sold-out inventory; other domain conflicts lose their meaning.
Recommended Message: Use the mapped conflict message. For room availability only: This room type is no longer available for these dates. Choose another room type.

Existing Message: const notify = (message: string) => { toastController.push({ title: message, tone: "success" }); };
Problem: Errors and warnings route through a hard-coded success tone and icon.
Recommended Message: Keep each action's specific error message; display errors with error tone and unresolved outcomes with warning tone.

Existing Message: const notify = (message: string) => { toastController.push({ title: message }) };
Problem: Errors default to informational tone; notify signature does not carry severity.
Recommended Message: Keep each action's specific message; pass error, warning, info or success explicitly.

Existing Message: const notify = (message: string) => { toastController.push({ title: message }); };
Problem: Errors default to informational tone.
Recommended Message: Keep each action's specific message; pass error, warning, info or success explicitly.

Existing Message: throw new Error(result.error
Problem: Any response error becomes a displayable Error; caught network exceptions are also shown verbatim.
Recommended Message: Use a trusted error decoder. Read failure: We couldn't load this information. Please try again. Write uncertainty: We couldn't confirm the update. Check the record before trying again.

Existing Message: ${valid.error.issues[0].path.join
Problem: Internal schema paths and library text are rendered to editors.
Recommended Message: Please check the highlighted website content fields.

Existing Message: error.issues[0]?.message
Problem: Default Zod text is returned as the primary error and individual fields; both need safe formatting.
Recommended Message: Please check the highlighted details. Each field receives a specific instruction, such as Please enter your first name.

Existing Message: issue.path.filter(part => typeof part === "string").at(-1)
Problem: Leaf-only paths lose nesting and array indexes; nested transport fields may not identify the matching control.
Recommended Message: Keep the complete field path internally and map it to the actual form control and a guest-facing label.

Existing Message: setError(body.error ??
Problem: The first field error is also displayed as a form alert while the same field has role=alert.
Recommended Message: Please check the highlighted details. Announce the summary once, link it to fields, and keep each field's own instruction near the input.

Existing Message: Use a password of at most 72 UTF-8 bytes. Some characters use more than one byte.
Problem: Explains the implementation instead of giving a usable correction; keep the byte limit unchanged.
Recommended Message: This password is too long. Use a shorter password; some characters take more space.

Existing Message: setToasts((current) => current.filter((item) => item.id !== toast.id))
Problem: Automatic expiry removes a visible toast without promoting queued messages. Notifications can remain unseen.
Recommended Message: No copy change. Promote the next queued toast on automatic expiry and dismissal; retain important errors until acknowledged.

Existing Message: if (current.some((existing) => existing.id
Problem: Deduplication checks visible IDs only; queued repeats can accumulate. A repeated push also plays sound before this check.
Recommended Message: No copy change. Deduplicate visible and queued notifications by action/request ID before playing sound.

Existing Message: role="log" aria-live="polite"
Problem: A live container nests child alert/status live regions. Duplicate announcements are a risk requiring screen-reader verification.
Recommended Message: Use one announcement owner per result. Field errors remain associated with controls; action-level errors use one live region.

Existing Message: if (attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS)
Problem: Attempt limit is checked only inside try; repeated network rejection bypasses it and provides no connection state.
Recommended Message: We couldn't refresh your payment status. Please check your connection, then check this reservation before paying again.

Existing Message: if (state === "done") return null;
Problem: Polling limit silently removes the watcher message without explaining how to recover.
Recommended Message: Payment confirmation is taking longer than expected. Check your reservation or contact Front Desk before paying again.

Existing Message: The receipt could not be emailed.
Problem: Fetch catch claims a failed delivery although the request may have been accepted.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm that the receipt email was sent. Check your inbox before trying again.

Existing Message: Could not release this hold. Please try again.
Problem: Network catch can follow a successful release; error implies a known failure.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm whether the hold was released. Refresh your bookings to check its status.

Existing Message: Unable to cancel this payment attempt. Please try again.
Problem: Network failure cannot establish cancellation outcome.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm the payment cancellation. Check your reservation and payment status before trying again.

Existing Message: error instanceof Error ? error.message
Problem: A broad catch returns any parser/stream Error text. Safe authored image validation and unexpected failures are not separated.
Recommended Message: For invalid image content: Choose a valid JPEG, PNG or WebP photo. For an unreadable upload: We couldn't read this photo. Please choose it again.

Existing Message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message
Problem: Broad upload catch can reveal form-data parser exceptions.
Recommended Message: We couldn't read this image. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP file and try again.

Existing Message: cause instanceof Error && !(cause instanceof z.ZodError) ? cause.message
Problem: Excludes ZodError but still exposes arbitrary parser or stream Error messages.
Recommended Message: We couldn't read this photo. Choose a valid image, add a description, and try again.

Existing Message: Cash exception history is unavailable. Try again or check pending migrations.
Problem: Asks Accounting to diagnose database rollout.
Recommended Message: Cash exception history is unavailable right now. Try again shortly, or contact the system administrator if it continues.

Existing Message: Preventive work is unavailable. Check pending migrations or retry.
Problem: Technicians cannot resolve migration state.
Recommended Message: Preventive maintenance is unavailable right now. Try again shortly, or contact the system administrator.

Existing Message: Operational handover service is unavailable. Try again or ask an administrator to check pending migrations.
Problem: Operational message includes deployment detail.
Recommended Message: Handovers are unavailable right now. Try again shortly, or contact the system administrator.

Existing Message: Schedule and handover service is unavailable. Try again or ask an administrator to check pending migrations.
Problem: Operational message includes deployment detail.
Recommended Message: Schedules and handovers are unavailable right now. Try again shortly, or contact the system administrator.

Existing Message: Lost & Found is unavailable. Check pending migrations or try again.
Problem: Staff cannot apply schema changes.
Recommended Message: Lost & Found is unavailable right now. Try again shortly, or contact the system administrator.

Existing Message: This retry key belongs to a different charge.
Problem: Internal idempotency term rather than an operational recovery instruction.
Recommended Message: These charge details differ from the earlier submission. Check the folio before starting a new charge.

Existing Message: This retry key belongs to a different operation.
Problem: Technical internal retry identity exposed.
Recommended Message: These details differ from the earlier submission. Check the record before starting a new action.

Existing Message: Version is required to edit a draft.
Problem: Internal concurrency field; user cannot enter a record version.
Recommended Message: Reopen the latest purchase order draft before editing it.

Existing Message: Status and current version are required.
Problem: Version is a client concurrency token, not a field the user should supply.
Recommended Message: Choose an account status. If it is already selected, reopen the account and try again.

Existing Message: A decision, current version, and (for returns) a note are required.
Problem: Mixes a missing field with a stale page and uses an internal version term.
Recommended Message: Choose a review decision and add a note if returning the report. If these details are complete, reopen the latest report.

Existing Message: The room is maintenance-blocked.
Problem: Awkward technical compound; retain the operational maintenance distinction.
Recommended Message: This room is unavailable while maintenance work is open. Choose another eligible room.

Existing Message: Checklist and notes are invalid.
Problem: Does not identify which answer needs attention.
Recommended Message: Please check the highlighted checklist items and notes.

Existing Message: A failure reason is required.
Problem: Unclear whether the form or inspection failed.
Recommended Message: Please explain why the room did not pass inspection.

Existing Message: Availability changed while you were booking. Choose another room.
Problem: Can be more specific about the selected dates.
Recommended Message: This room is no longer available for your selected dates. Please choose another room.

Existing Message: Requests require a confirmed or current stay.
Problem: Describes a system constraint without giving the guest a route forward.
Recommended Message: You can make a request once your reservation is confirmed. Contact Front Desk if you need help before then.

Existing Message: This reservation can no longer be cancelled.
Problem: Does not provide the available assistance route.
Recommended Message: This reservation can no longer be cancelled online. Please contact Front Desk for help.

Existing Message: A reservation change is already awaiting review or execution.
Problem: Internal execution stage is not guest-friendly.
Recommended Message: A change to this reservation is already being reviewed or completed. Check its status before requesting another change.

Existing Message: Unable to calculate the cancellation settlement. Please retry.
Problem: Settlement is finance terminology; the guest is checking cancellation charges/refund.
Recommended Message: We couldn't load the cancellation charges and refund details. Please try again before confirming the cancellation.

Existing Message: Transportation requires a confirmed or current stay.
Problem: Business rule lacks a next step.
Recommended Message: You can request transportation once your reservation is confirmed. Contact Front Desk if you need help before then.

Existing Message: This payment already went through — nothing to cancel.
Problem: Casual wording for a financial result.
Recommended Message: This payment has already been confirmed and cannot be cancelled here. Please contact Front Desk if you need help.

Existing Message: Only an unsettled online payment can be cancelled.
Problem: Unsettled is payment-system jargon.
Recommended Message: Only an online payment that is still awaiting confirmation can be cancelled here.

Existing Message: SMTP connection or authentication failed.
Problem: SMTP is appropriate for System Admin, but the recovery step is missing.
Recommended Message: We couldn't connect to the email service. Check the SMTP settings and credentials, then test the connection again.

Existing Message: error: sent.message
Problem: Account email helper may return SMTP setup text or No recipient address to a guest.
Recommended Message: We couldn't send the reset link right now. Please try again shortly or contact Front Desk.

Existing Message: error: "EMAIL_FAILED", message: result.message
Problem: Machine discriminator must stay stable; shared delivery message may contain configuration jargon.
Recommended Message: Keep EMAIL_FAILED for compatibility. Safe message: We couldn't send the receipt email right now. You can download your receipt instead.

Existing Message: details:typeof err.details
Problem: Raw database details/hint can contain row values. Server-side logging alone is not redaction.
Recommended Message: No user copy. Log only a request ID, operation and allowlisted diagnostic code; redact SQL detail, credentials, tokens, guest data and payment data.

Existing Message: error.message
Problem: Raw notification-insert DB message is logged; constraint errors can include values.
Recommended Message: No user copy. Log an allowlisted error code and notification type with a request ID.

Existing Message: console.error("guest reminder pass failed", error)
Problem: Entire exception object is logged; sensitive content is not structurally excluded.
Recommended Message: No user copy. Log a bounded, redacted diagnostic event with the operation and request ID.

Existing Message: notify("Seats must be a whole number from 1 to 20.")
Problem: Field validation uses a transient action toast instead of a persistent field error.
Recommended Message: Please enter a whole number of seats from 1 to 20. Display beside Seats and focus that field.

Existing Message: notify("Enter a plan name (at least 3 characters).")
Problem: Plan-name validation is shown as a toast; it can disappear while editing.
Recommended Message: Please enter a plan name with at least 3 characters. Display beside Plan name.

Existing Message: New passwords do not match.
Problem: Form-level text should be attached to Confirm new password.
Recommended Message: Please enter the same new password in both fields.

Existing Message: Network error while saving profile. Please check your connection.
Problem: Saving may already have completed; network cause is asserted for every caught exception.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm your profile update. Reopen your profile to check it before trying again.

Existing Message: That email or password doesn’t match our records.
Problem: Already concise and does not reveal which credential was wrong; retain.
Recommended Message: That email or password doesn’t match our records.

Existing Message: Could not confirm the password change. Try signing in with your new password before submitting again.
Problem: Already truthful about uncertainty and gives a concrete recovery route; retain.
Recommended Message: Could not confirm the password change. Try signing in with your new password before submitting again.

Existing Message: Try again or check the reservation status in My reservations before submitting another payment.
Problem: Already prevents accidental duplicate payments; keep. retry is correct for this installed Next.js version.
Recommended Message: Try again or check the reservation status in My reservations before submitting another payment.

Existing Message: Required / String must contain at least 1 character(s)
Problem: Observed from the installed Zod library; the API forwards issue.message and can expose this default wording. Keep the validation rule unchanged.
Recommended Message: Please enter your first name.

Existing Message: Required / String must contain at least 1 character(s)
Problem: Observed from the installed Zod library; the API forwards issue.message and can expose this default wording. Keep the validation rule unchanged.
Recommended Message: Please enter your last name.

Existing Message: Invalid email
Problem: Observed from the installed Zod library; the API forwards issue.message and can expose this default wording. Keep the validation rule unchanged.
Recommended Message: Please enter a valid email address.

Existing Message: Expected integer, received float
Problem: Observed from the installed Zod library; the API forwards issue.message and can expose this default wording. Keep the validation rule unchanged.
Recommended Message: Please enter a whole number of guests.

Existing Message: Number must be greater than or equal to 1
Problem: Observed from the installed Zod library; the API forwards issue.message and can expose this default wording. Keep the validation rule unchanged.
Recommended Message: Please include at least one guest. Apply the field-specific minimum and maximum for other integer fields.

Existing Message: String must contain at most 1000 character(s)
Problem: Observed from the installed Zod library; the API forwards issue.message and can expose this default wording. Keep the validation rule unchanged.
Recommended Message: Please keep special requests to 1,000 characters or fewer.

Existing Message: Invalid uuid
Problem: Observed from the installed Zod library; the API forwards issue.message and can expose this default wording. Keep the validation rule unchanged.
Recommended Message: Reopen the booking page to continue. Do not ask the guest to enter an internal identifier.

Existing Message: Invalid enum value. Expected 'Front Desk' | 'Walk-In' | 'Phone', received 'x'
Problem: Observed from the installed Zod library; the API forwards issue.message and can expose this default wording. Keep the validation rule unchanged.
Recommended Message: Please choose Front Desk, Walk-In or Phone as the booking source.

Existing Message: "Unable to create the reservation."
Problem: Unknown RPC failures are all returned as 409 and the caller then assumes availability conflict. Preserve current statuses during the copy rollout, but use an explicit safe code instead of inferring business meaning from status alone.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm this reservation. Check Reservations before starting another booking. Known availability rejection keeps its specific room-conflict message.

Existing Message: e instanceof Error ? e.message
Problem: Any network exception is rendered raw and an unknown withdrawal has no status-check guidance.
Recommended Message: We couldn't confirm the withdrawal. Check the request status before trying again.

Existing Message: This action must come from the Haven website.
Problem: The request boundary can surface a technical origin restriction without a clear recovery action. Keep origin/CSRF checks unchanged.
Recommended Message: Please reopen the Haven website and try this action again.

Existing Message: Use a supported request format.
Problem: 415 feedback asks a guest or staff member to change an HTTP request format. Keep accepted content types unchanged.
Recommended Message: We couldn't read this request. Refresh the page and try again.
